# signoz_ingestion_key (Resource)

Creates and manages ingestion key resources in SigNoz.

~> **Note:** The `value` attribute contains the actual API ingestion key and is only returned when the key is first created. It is stored in Terraform state and marked as sensitive. Subsequent reads may return an empty or masked value from the API, but the original value is preserved in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

resource "signoz_ingestion_key" "production" {
  name       = "Production Ingest Key"
  tags       = ["production", "team-a"]
  expires_at = ""

  rate_limits = {
    day_limit    = 1000000
    second_limit = 1000
  }
}

output "ingestion_key" {
  value     = signoz_ingestion_key.production
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the ingestion key.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Expiration time of the ingestion key.
- `rate_limits` (Attributes) Rate limits for the ingestion key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limits))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the ingestion key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the ingestion key.
- `id` (String) Autogenerated unique ID for the ingestion key.
- `ingestion_url` (String) The ingestion URL associated with this key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the ingestion key.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The ingestion key value. Only returned on creation.

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limits`

Optional:

- `day_limit` (Number) Maximum number of requests per day.
- `second_limit` (Number) Maximum number of requests per second.
